parameters.query: SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.messages, s.sections_covered, s.contact_email, s.contact_name, b.identity AS baseline_identity, b.tone AS baseline_tone, b.priorities AS baseline_priorities, b.red_lines AS baseline_red_lines, b.visit_checklist AS baseline_visit_checklist, b.materials_pref AS baseline_materials_pref, b.trades_pref AS baseline_trades_pref, b.jurisdiction AS baseline_jurisdiction FROM onboarding_sessions s, (SELECT * FROM studio_profile WHERE setup_source='baseline' AND active=true ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1) b WHERE s.id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO studio_profile (identity, tone, priorities, red_lines, visit_checklist, materials_pref, trades_pref, jurisdiction, setup_source, setup_completed_at, active) VALUES ($1::jsonb, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, 'onboarding_chat', now(), true) RETURNING studio_id;
UPDATE studio_profile SET active = false WHERE setup_source = 'baseline' AND studio_id <> $1::uuid;
UPDATE onboarding_sessions SET studio_id = $1::uuid, status = 'completed' WHERE id = $2::uuid;
SELECT value AS architect_email FROM system_config WHERE key = 'architect_email' LIMIT 1;
